During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''cell''' of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] partisans operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrahban]] despite its neutrality. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Invasion of Sarrahban|invaded]] the planet, the cell evacuated aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Harvest Moon]]''.<ref name="TRG1-115" />
